QUOTE: Deny entries are consulted in `ServerManager::execute`, so a denied call fails even if auto-approve or the callback approved it.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute and overrides approval, but it also describes other blocking checks (anti-spiral, schema, MCP authorization, tier, duplicate, and a no-callback denial). It never concludes that the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution.
